# Open Set Consulting

> Independent technology advisory and leadership coaching, based in Richmond, Virginia. Run by Erin Geoghan, an engineering and product leader with a decade leading cloud product teams in regulated industries.

## Leadership coaching (opensetconsulting.com/coaching.html)

One-on-one coaching for engineering and product leaders, in person in Richmond, VA or on video anywhere in the United States. Two formats:

- Leadership Coaching: goals set in the first month, an hour together roughly every other week, periodic check-ins with the leader's manager or HR. $700 per leader per month on a 3 month term, $630 on a 6 month term. Nonprofits take 30% off.
- The Technical Leadership Residency: built around one business initiative the leader holds, one measurable outcome per 90 day cycle, async review of progress between sessions, a readout to their executive at day 90. $1,000 per leader per month on a 3 month term, $900 on a 6 month term.

Posted rates cover leaders up through the director level. Executive and C-suite engagements are scoped individually. Sessions are confidential; the leader's manager gets progress against goals, not the conversation.

## Consulting (opensetconsulting.com)

Advisory and hands-on help for CEOs, COOs, and technology leaders turning AI investment into results the business can see, without losing control of quality or spend.
